newsitem.title: USA: Petsec Energy finds more Main Pass gas.
newsitem.headline: Petsec Energy finds more Main Pass gas.

text.p: Petsec Energy Ltd said Friday its Main Pass 104-2 well intersected seven natural gas sands with a combined vertical thickness of 23 meters (75 feet) in a test of a separate structure from the one found by the Main Pass 104-1 well.
In a statement released in New York, the company noted the first well was completed for gas production in mid-July, having discovered nine meters (28 feet) of vertical thickness in two sands.
Following the completion of the 2 well, a third well is proposed to test another separate structure, the company added.
